tree.heading: New projects and facilities
tree.text: All new projects or facilities constructed in accordance with this subchapter shall remain under the jurisdiction and control of the non-Federal borrower subject to the terms of the repayment agreement.

tree.heading: Existing projects and facilities
tree.text: Nothing in this subchapter affects the title of—

children.text: reclamation projects authorized prior to December 22, 2006;
works supplemental to existing reclamation projects; or
works constructed to rehabilitate existing reclamation projects.
